source_iast: cakrārūḍham anackaṃ vā kiṃ vā śaktisvarūpakam
parāyā yadi tadvat syāt paratvaṃ tad virudhyate
paratvaṃ niṣkalatvena sakalatve na tad bhavet
sādhu sādhu tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ tantrasāram idam priye
na cāsau triśirā devo na ca śaktitrayātmakaḥ
evaṃvidhe pare tattve kaḥ pūjyaḥ kaś ca tṛpyati
sā parā pararūpeṇa parā devī prakīrtitā
tadāsau śivarūpī syāt śaivī mukham ihocyate
jñāyate digvibhāgādi tadvac chaktyā śivaḥ priye
yathā samyag ahaṃ vedmi tathā me brūhi bhairava
ūrdhvaṃ muṣṭitrayaṃ yāvat tāvad ante mahodayaḥ
śūnye kuḍye pare pātre svayaṃ līnā varapradā
krameṇa manaso dārḍhyāt lakṣayet laṣyam uttamam
dṛṣṭe bindau kramāl līne tanmadhye paramā sthitiḥ
binduṃ śikhānte hṛdaye layānte dhyāyato layaḥ
śūnyayā parayā śaktyā śūnyatām eti bhairavi
vibhāvayet tatas tasya bhāvanā sā sthirā bhavet
na kiṃcid antare tasya dhyāyann adhyeyabhāg bhavet
pluṣṭam vicintayed ante śāntābhāsas tadā bhavet
tattvāni yāni nilayaṃ dhyātvānte vyajyate parā
praviśya hṛdaye dhyāyan muktaḥ svātantryam āpnuyāt
tatraiva ca mano līnaṃ tatas tallayabhājanam
tallayaṃ tatkṣaṇād gatvā tallayāt tanmayo bhavet
yugapac ca dvayaṃ tyaktvā madhye tattvam prakāśate
yat sukham brahmatattvasya tat sukhaṃ svākyam ucyate
ānandam udgataṃ dhyātvā tallayas tanmanā bhavet
sāvasthā manasā gamyā parā devī prakāśate
nidhāya tatprasaṅgena parā pūrṇā matir bhavet
kakṣavyomni manaḥ kurvan śamam āyāti tallayāt
acireṇa nirādhāraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā śivaṃ vrajet
hoccāraṃ manasā kurvaṃs tataḥ śānte pralīyate
svadehaṃ manasi kṣiṇe kṣaṇāt kṣīṇāśayo bhavet
praśānte mānase bhāve devi divyaugham āpnuyāt
stabdhātmā tatkṣaṇād devi bhairavaṃ vapur āpnuyāt
taimiram bhāvayan rūpam bhairavaṃ rūpam eṣyati
prasārya bhairavaṃ rūpam bhāvayaṃs tanmayo bhavet
nirāśrayā citiḥ śaktiḥ svarūpaṃ darśayet tadā
tatraiva cetanāṃ yuktvā bhairave nirmalā gatiḥ
ityādidharmaṃ tattvānāṃ kalayan na pṛthag bhavet
yata eva samudbhūtā tatas tatraiva līyate
tattvataḥ kasyacin naitad evambhāvī śivaḥ priye
ataś ca tanmayaṃ sarvam bhāvayan bhavajij janaḥ
buddhiṃ nistimitāṃ kṛtvā tat tattvam avaśiṣyate
bhramad vā dhyāyataḥ sarvam paśyataś ca sukhodgamaḥ
bhairavi jñāyatāṃ madhye kiṃ tattvam avaśiṣyate
dṛḍhena manasā dṛṣṭyā nānyekṣiṇyā sukhī bhavet
naiva sarvagataṃ jātam bhāvayan iti sarvagaḥ
apekṣāṃ svaśarīrasya tyaktvā vyāpī dinair bhavet
sa evāhaṃ śaivadharmā iti dārḍhyāc chivo bhavet
anackam ahalaṃ dhyāyan viśed brahma sanātanam
tatra tatra śivāvāsthā vyāpakatvāt kva yāsyati
taj jñānaṃ cittasahitaṃ devi śūnyālāyo bhavet
sā śaktiḥ śāṅkarī nityam bhavayet tāṃ tataḥ śivaḥ
tām eva manasā dhyātvā vidito 'pi praśāmyati
na śucir hy aśucis tasmān nirvikalpaḥ sukhī bhavet
na ca tadvyatirekteṇa paro 'stīty advayā gatiḥ
brahmaṇaḥ paripūrṇatvāt iti jñātvā sukhī bhavet
tat sarvam bhairavam bhāvyaṃ tadante bodhasambhavaḥ
kiṃ tattvam indrajālasya iti dārḍhyāc chamaṃ vrajet
jñānāyattā bahirbhāvā ataḥ śūnyam idaṃ jagat
pratibimbam idam buddher jaleṣv iva vivasvataḥ
yadā priye parikṣīṇaṃ tadā tad bhairavaṃ vapuḥ
dvādaśābhyadhikaṃ devi yaj jñātvā jñānavij janaḥ
idaṃ yadi vapur deva parāyāś ca maheśvara
dhyāyate ko mahānātha pūjyate kaś ca tṛpyati
eṣātra prakriyā bāhyā sthūleṣv eva mṛgekṣaṇe
japaḥ so 'tra svayaṃ nādo mantrātmā japya īdṛśaḥ
nirvikalpe mahāvyomni sā pūjā hy ādarāl layaḥ
hūyate manasā sārdhaṃ sa homaś cetanāsrucā
anyathā tasya tattvasya kā pūjā kāś ca tṛpyati
yaś caiva pūjakaḥ sarvaḥ sa evaikaḥ kva pūjanam
tayā devyā samāviṣṭaḥ param bhairavam āpnuyāt
japo devyāḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ sulabho durlabho jaḍaiḥ
etac ca naiva kasyāpi prakāśyaṃ tu kadācana
prāṇā api pradātavyā na deyaṃ paramāmṛtam
ity uktvānanditā devi ka.ṅthe lagnā śivasya tu
